notes.pipeline: Each attempt is research-first, then planning, implementation, deterministic tests, public/hidden guardrails, current-783 candidate evaluation, and one cheap ACCEPT/REJECT validator.
notes.models: Research and planning use the strongest configured model. Implementation and final mechanism/value validation use gpt-5.5 with low reasoning by default.
notes.campaign: Default campaign is five scientific iterations. --max-cycles may override it up to seven. Infrastructure pauses do not consume a scientific iteration.
notes.benchmark: Public GOLD and hidden validation are correctness/safety guardrails. Regressions are rejected before the expensive current-dataset candidate evaluation.
notes.optimization: The 783-row current tender dataset is the primary optimization/research corpus. It is mostly unlabeled, so MATCHED count is diagnostic only; candidate value is judged from defensible stage/product transitions while labeled guardrails remain flat-or-better.
notes.supporting_corpus: The older 253-row real-tender corpus and its first-pass labels remain supporting evidence for causal research, not the primary optimization target.
notes.review: Candidates that survive public/hidden guardrails receive a full 783-row candidate comparison before the cheap gpt-5.5-low ACCEPT/REJECT validator. No Fixer pass is budgeted.
notes.indexing: Agents may request a rebuild but must not run a full rebuild themselves. The supervisor owns the global budget of five rebuilds.
